The design stays exactly identical: savage cave bat with large leathery dark brown-grey wings spread wide on thick bony finger struts, a stocky furry dark grey-brown body, big pointed ears, glowing red eyes, a blunt pig-like snout with small white fangs, and little clawed feet hanging below.
